description: Create services layer with all business logic and calculation methods. 7 services (FinanceService, BudgetService, SavingsService, AnalyticsService, NotificationService, AIService, VoiceService) that process data from repositories and provide computed values. AIService implements rule-based chat with pattern matching for spending analysis, budget queries, savings tips, and affordability checks. Depends on FEAT-001 models.
steps: Create lib/services/finance_service.dart with methods: calculateTotalIncome(transactions, dateRange), calculateTotalExpenses(transactions, dateRange), calculateBalance(transactions), getTransactionsByCategory(transactions, categoryId), getTransactionsByDateRange(transactions, startDate, endDate). Takes transactions list as parameter.

Create lib/services/budget_service.dart with methods: calculateSpentForBudget(transactions, budget), calculateRemaining(budget, spent), getBudgetStatus(spent, limit) returning 'green' (<70%), 'yellow' (70-99%), 'red' (>=100%), checkBudgetWarnings(budgets, transactions) returning list of over-budget warnings
Create lib/services/savings_service.dart with methods: calculateProgress(goal) returning percentage, calculateDaysRemaining(goal), calculateMonthlyTarget(goal) suggesting monthly savings needed

Create lib/services/analytics_service.dart with methods: getSpendingByCategory(transactions, dateRange) returning Map<String,double>, getMonthlyTrend(transactions, months) returning List<double>, getWeeklyTrend(transactions, weeks) returning List<double>, compareWithPreviousPeriod(transactions, currentStart, currentEnd) returning percentage difference

Create lib/services/notification_service.dart with methods: createBudgetWarning(budget, spent), createGoalReminder(goal, daysUntilTarget), createWeeklySummary(transactions, weekStart, weekEnd), createTransactionReminder() - each returns NotificationItem model instance

Create lib/services/ai_service.dart with processMessage(String query, List<Transaction> transactions, List<Budget> budgets, List<SavingsGoal> goals) returning String response. Implement rule-based pattern matching: detect 'how much', 'spent', 'spending' for spending queries; 'where', 'money go', 'category' for category breakdown; 'afford', 'can I buy' for affordability checks; 'save', 'saving', 'tips' for savings advice; 'budget' for budget status. Include fallback responses and helpful suggestions.

Create lib/services/voice_service.dart with parseVoiceCommand(String command) stub method returning placeholder Map<String,dynamic> with 'action' and 'params' keys. Comment indicating future speech-to-text integration point.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 service files exist in lib/services/ with documented public methods
FinanceService correctly calculates income, expenses, and balance from transaction lists
BudgetService implements three-tier status system (green/yellow/red) based on percentage thresholds
SavingsService calculates progress percentage and monthly targets accurately
AnalyticsService provides trend data and period comparisons
AIService responds to at least 5 query patterns with relevant answers using transaction/budget/goal data
VoiceService has stub implementation ready for future integration
No compilation errors when running flutter analyze
verification: Run 'flutter analyze' and confirm no errors in lib/services/
Verify all service methods are present and have appropriate return types
Check AIService has pattern matching logic for multiple query types
